title: What a virtual function costs
description:
An object with any virtual function carries one hidden pointer (the *vptr*) to its class's table of virtual functions. See it for yourself.

Write two structs with the same two `double` members, `x` and `y`:

- `PlainPoint`: nothing else;
- `VirtualPoint`: also has a virtual destructor (`virtual ~VirtualPoint() = default;`).

Then write `std::size_t vptrCost()` returning how many bytes bigger the second one is. Compute it with `sizeof`; do not type a number.
hints: `return sizeof(VirtualPoint) - sizeof(PlainPoint);`. On a 64-bit system that is 8: the size of one hidden pointer.
